Commentary.Commentary: We are back for New Zealand's reply! The players stride out to the middle. Suzie Bates and Sophie Devine are the openers for New Zealand Women. Ellyse Perry will start things off. Let's go...
... THE CHASE ...

Now the target is a big one! Above 260 is yet to be chased in this World Cup. Can it happen today? New Zealand will have to bat brilliantly and a lot will depend on the top 4. Australia on the other hand, will back themselves to defend it, they have quality bowlers in their ranks. Can they do so? We will find out.

Tahlia McGrath is up for a chat. She says that it was a difficult wicket to start on. Tells that the cutters were holding in it a bit and 280 was par but the way they got up to that total of 269 was great. On asked about what were the plans during batting with Perry, she says that they were talking about giving themselves a platform to score big thereafter. Adds that she loves batting with her. Tells that they have to be pretty good with the ball as New Zealand bowled really well and their fielding was excellent.

The bowling was brilliant for most parts! The new ball bowlers began brilliantly. Jansen, the Kerr sisters and Tahuhu bowled with tremendous control and also got wickets at regular intervals. However, in the last 15 overs or so, it all went downhill for the hosts. Their bowlers were taken to the cleaners and they just succumbed under pressure. There were far too many poor balls and the fielding standards also dropped big time. They will not be pleased with where things have ended especially after the start they had got.

Then came the fightback courtesy Mooney and Perry. Both added above 50 and took the Aussies to safer shores. Then came the stand though which provided the much-needed impetus to the Aussie innings and it was a stand between Perry and Tahlia McGrath. Both accounted for over 100 with the two scoring half tons. However, the best was saved for the last though. Ashleigh Gardner who is making a comeback into the side walked out and smashed the ball all around the park. She ensured Australia finish strongly and she is a big reason as to why the Aussies scored over 100 in the last 10. That innings has powered them to a total which is just above par we feel.

That innings from Gardner has probably taken the game away from the Kiwis! Absolute carnage. 4 fours and 4 sixes and let me tell you, this is not a small ground, it is a huge playing space and she has taken the bowlers to the cleaners. Surely Australia will be the happier side of the two heading into the break. Especially after they were reeling at 56 for 3.

SIX! Ashleigh Gardner finishes strongly for Australia Women! She has played a terrific knock for her side. 48 off just 18 balls. Take a bow. She pulls this short ball for a flat six over deep square leg. Australia Women finish with 269/8.

DROPPED! Everything is happening here. Slower delivery in the slot around off, Gardner makes room and heaves it high off the splice before it drops towards point. A regulation catch goes down though as Hannah Rowe makes a meal of it before the batters race back for the second run.
Full and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner swings but only to connect it with thin air.
FOUR! She's playing a blinder! Short ball, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner makes room again and plays an upper cut that flies over short third man for another boundary.
FOUR! Ashleigh Gardner moves a long way across and Lea Tahuhu delivers a full ball, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner slices it over backward point for a boundary.

OUT! RUN OUT! Length ball, on middle. Amanda-Jade Wellington drives it towards and sets off for a quick single. Frances Mackay there collects it and fires an underarm throw at the bowler's end while she's on her knees. The ball goes on to hit the stumps and Amanda-Jade Wellington is caught well short. Australia Women wouldn't mind this though as Ashleigh Gardner is back on strike. Megan Schutt is the new batter in.
Short ball again, on middle. Ashleigh Gardner misses her pull.
First dot that Ashleigh Gardner faces! Slower short ball, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner fails to cut it away.
SIX! This is sensational stuff! 32 off just 11 deliveries. Full and on off, Ashleigh Gardner makes room and pummels it over long off for another biggie.
SIX! BOOM! The six-hitting power of Ashleigh Gardner is phenomenal. Length ball, on middle and leg. Ashleigh Gardner shimmies down the track and tonks it over long on for a biggie.
Amanda-Jade Wellington does the right thing, she gets Gardner on strike! On off, this is hit to covers. Quick run taken.
Hannah Rowe takes the pace off and bowls it on a length, on leg. Ashleigh Gardner slogs it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A dot to end! Full and on middle, Amanda-Jade Wellington pushes it to point.
Short ball, on middle. Ashleigh Gardner mistimes her pull to square leg for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Another catch for Suzie Bates and she helds on! Length ball, on middle. Alana King looks to heave it on the leg side. Miscues her shot and it goes off the top edge towards mid on. A little bit of miscommunication between the mid on and mid off fielder but Suzie Bates takes it easily in the end. Amanda-Jade Wellington comes out to bat.
Commentary.Howout: c Suzie Bates b Lea Tahuhu

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball, on off. Pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! Goes the distance! Ashleigh Gardner is very strong! In the slot, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner hammers it over long on. The ball stays in the air for quite a long time but goes all the way for a maximum.
Length ball, on middle. Alana King guides it to third man for a single.
Slower delivery outside off, King pushes it wide of cover for a quick single.
Put down! A tough chance though! Length ball, outside off. Alana King hits it hard back to the bowler. Hannah Rowe gets low and tries to take the catch but the ball pops out of her hands.
Length ball, outside off, Alana King looks to steer it down to third man but misses.
Alana King walks out to bat!

OUT! CAUGHT! Hannah Rowe gets her first wicket and removes the set batter, Tahlia McGrath! This could well make a difference of 20 runs in the end. Length ball, on off. Tahlia McGrath tries to smash it over mid off but got too close to the pitch of the ball and ends up hitting it straight to Suzie Bates at mid off. Australia Women six down now. An excellent knock from Tahlia McGrath comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Suzie Bates b Hannah Rowe

Commentary.Commentary: Good length, outside off. Gardner works it to the off side for a single.
FOUR! This is amazing batting! Short of a length, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner carves it uppishly and over covers to get another boundary. She is so good to watch!

Slightly short, on off. Tahlia McGrath pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Amelia Kerr there runs to her right and slides to stop the ball right on the boundaryline. She parries it to the covering fielder and saves a couple of runs.
On a length, around off. Ashleigh Gardner hangs back and steers it down to deep point for another single.
Fuller, on off. Tahlia McGrath pushes it towards covers for a run.
Short of a length, on middle. Ashleigh Gardner mistimes her pull to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Wonderful! Ashleigh Gardner doesn't waste time and gets off the mark. Length ball, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner cuts it behind point. Finds the gap and gets a boundary.
Length ball, on off. Tahlia McGrath covers the line and tucks it on the leg side for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a sensational catch from Maddy Green! Wow, just wow! We have seen a few screamers but this is right up there. Absolute beaut! And this will surely lift the Kiwi side. They seem flat at the moment but this can surely give them a lift. Ellyse Perry can't believe it. She must have thought, it is a boundary for sure. This is fuller and on leg, Perry slams it down the ground. She was quite relaxed after hitting it. Green at long on, runs to her left, dives full stretch and takes it brilliantly. Now can this help New Zealand end well? Ashleigh Gardner walks out to bat.
Commentary.Howout: c Maddy Green b Lea Tahuhu

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length around off, gets high on the bat of McGrath as she backs away and swats a pull high towards long on. Just short of the fielder there. A single!

100-run stand comes up between these two! It has been amazing batting from these two! They have complimented each other very well. Ellyse Perry clips this overpitched delivery to deep square leg for a single.
A bouncer, on middle, Tahlia McGrath advances down the track and slaps it to long on. Ellyse Perry does well to get out of the way. The ball went right past her head.
Lovely bowling! Full and on middle, Tahlia McGrath smashes it back to the bowler. Lea Tahuhu does well to stop the ball on her followthrough.
Tahlia McGrath makes room and Lea Tahuhu follows her with a length ball, Tahlia McGrath goes for the big heave but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Goes short and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one. End of another big over and Amelia Kerr is going for runs in this spell.

FOUR! Finds the gap and gets to her fifty in style! A fifty in just 47 balls. Just the kind of innings her side needed. What a player she is proving to be. Certainly one of the best going around at the moment. She comes down the track and this time gets to the pitch of it. It is hit through covers for a boundary.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! The wheels are coming off now for the Kiwis. A misifeld. They have been brilliant in the field so far but are now feeling the pressure. Tahlia McGrath brings out the reverse sweep, she hits it, not off the middle but well enough towards short third man. The fielder there lets it through and it goes to the fence behind.
Tahlia McGrath comes down the track, she does not get to the pitch of it but still swings, it goes off the bottom towards mid off.
Wee bit of turn! Shorter and around off, this one spins away. It is pushed through covers for one.
Two more and the 200 is up! Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point for two.

FOUR! More runs! Edgy but Australia Women won't care! Tahlia McGrath steps out, this is banged short and outside off, she slashes, it goes off the outside edge, past short third man and into the fence. She moves into the 40s.
This is a brilliant over so far from Lea Tahuhu! Tahlia McGrath makes room and she is followed. She swings hard but misses.
Angled into the pads, Perry works it through square leg for one.
Short again, wanting the batters to hit towards the longer part of the ground. Perry had come down the track and hence, lets it go.
Tahlia McGrath makes room! This is banged in short. It is pulled towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, Perry pushes it through covers for one.
Once again looks to repeat the same! Shuffles across and looks to sweep, this is way too full and outside off. She misses to get hit on the pads.
FOUR! That is very nicely played! Gets it nice and fine! Tahlia McGrath walks across and this is tossed up outside off, she sweeps it fine and into the fine leg fence.
Outside off, Perry strokes it through covers for one.
Two! Nice and fine! On the pads, Perry works it fine and takes two.
Flatter and on middle, Perry works it to mid-wicket.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
A dot to end but the damage was done earlier on! On off, it is driven to mid off.
SIX! BANG! That goes all the way and this could well be the momentum changing over. This is full and on middle, it is heaved over the mid-wicket fence. Takes full toll of the Free Hit.

NO BALL AND FOUR! Fifty for Perry! What an innings from one of the greatest. Her side was in trouble now, she has taken her team into a good position, still 9 overs to go after this one and she would want to stay there till the end. A gift for her to get to that milestone. A full toss on middle, this is pulled wide of deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Free Hit coming up.
Fuller and outside off, this is creamed through covers for a boundary.
Well fielded! That could have well been anotehr boundary! Outside off, Tahlia McGrath swings, it goes off the outside edge, the fielder at short third man dives and stops it.
FOUR! That is Tahlia McGrath at her best! She loves playing that cover drive and it is a delight to watch. This is fuller and outside off, Tahlia McGrath strokes it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Short and put away! Excellent start to Powerplay 3! Tahlia McGrath moves right across and this is bowled short and outside off, she drags it through square leg for a boundary.
End of Powerplay 2! 4 fielders are now allowed the inner circle till the end of the innigs.

Two to end and the 50-run stand is up! Consecutive ones for Australia. They are in a decent position now and well and truly cant think of the 250-run mark but the two hold the key. This is angled into middle, it is worked through mid-wicket, in the gap, two taken.
Perry looks to be cheeky, she tries to play the paddle scoop but this is bowled outside off. She then tries to guide it down to third man but misses.
Another dot! Jess Kerr has been really good! On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
That was a risky shot! Tahlia McGrath moves right across and this is a slower one on middle, she hits it down to fine leg for one. All that risk for only one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Does not find the gap! Hits it well but to the fielder! Shorter and outside off, it is cut to point.
On the pads, Tahlia McGrath looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. A dot to end but a good over for the Aussies.
A single now as this is flicked through mid-wicket.
Follows the boundary with a single as this is hit through covers.
FOUR! Powered down the ground! Tahlia McGrath steps out and gets to the pitch of it. It is hammered down the ground past mid off for a boundary.
Outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
That is outstanding fielding! Saves three there does Suzie Bates! Outside off, shorter, it is cut hard towards point. Bates dives and saves three for her side.
A single! On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket for one. Another good over by Kerr.

New Zealand Women have taken a review for caught behind. The umpire has given it as wide though. UltraEdge shows there is a flat line as the ball passes the bat. The original decision stands and it will remain as a wide. New Zealand Women lose their review.

NOT OUT! However, Tahlia McGrath would have had her heart in her mouth for a second when the umpire said by mistake, there is a spike. She though changed it quickly. A review goes down the drain for the Kiwis as that touched nothing. Down the leg side. Tahlia McGrath looks to pull but misses. Martin takes it and appeals. The umpire signals a wide. Martin wants it to be reviewed and it is taken. She though is quite embaressed after looking at the first replay as it shows a big gap between bat and pad. The on-field call stays.
Just the one and the 150 comes up! Australia would want at least 100 more. On the pads, this is clipped through mid-wicket for one.
Another dot! Shorter and outside off, Perry makes room, she cuits it nicely but to point.
Fuller and on middle, Perry works it to mid on. The two Kerrs are really bowling well.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.

Just short! Tahlia McGrath would have been worried there for a minute! On middle, Tahila looks to go over mid on but it goes off the toe-end. Lands just short of mid on who dives forward. Does well to stop it in the end.
Sensible batting then in that over! On middle, Tahlia McGrath works it towards mid-wicket and takes one.
Just the one again! Outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Good length and outside off, this one lands and holds its line. Tahila looks to push at it but is beaten.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Two! Angled into the pads, this is worked behind square on the leg side, two taken.

Tahlia McGrath would feel she missed out there! That is a very good over from Jess Kerr! The last ball was not a good one though as it is short and down the leg side, gets away with it as Tahila misses the pull and gets hit on the pads.
Another dot! On off, this is driven to covers.
On off, Tahlia McGrath goes back and blocks.
Another single! Outside off, this is carved through point for one.
On the fuller side again, this is pushed to mid off.
Fuller and outside off, this is driven through covers for one.
Length ball, on off. Perry dabs it down to short third man.
On off, played to mid on.
Good length, outside off. Tahlia McGrath steers it to deep point for a run.
Full and on off, Ellyse Perry drives it to long off for a single.
On a length, outside off. Tahlia McGrath guides it to sweeper cover for one.
FOUR! What a shot! Hayley Jensen bowls a length ball, in the slot and Tahlia McGrath gets behind the line and lofts it over the bowler's head to get a boundary. Well timed that!
Floats it up, on off. Perry works it to mid-wicket off the back foot.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.
On middle, blocked out.
FOUR! Hit hard! Full and on middle, Ellyse Perry stands tall and smacks it past the bowler for a boundary. That went like a bullet!
Short and on middle, Tahlia McGrath works it to covers for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Tahlia McGrath defends.
Touch fuller, on off. Ellyse Perry lifts it over covers. Didn't hit it with a lot of power and will only get two.
Short of a length, on middle. Tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
On a good length, on off. Tahlia McGrath pushes it to mid on.
WIDE! A bouncer, on off, well over the batter's head. Tahlia McGrath leaves it alone. Wide called for height.
Length ball, outside off. Tahlia McGrath looks to push it away from the body but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Slower delivery, outside off. Tahlia McGrath leans and pushes it to point. Amelia Kerr with an excellent dive there.
Short of a length, on middle. Ellyse Perry pulls it to deep square leg. There is a fielder stationed there and will only get a single.
Shor again, outside off. Ellyse Perry cuts it to point. The fielder there misfields and allows the batters to take a single. Ellyse Perry will retain the strike.
Short and on off, Tahlia McGrath punches it towards covers for a run.
Full and on off, driven through covers for a single.
On off, kept out.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Poor ball from Amelia Kerr! Short and down leg, Ellyse Perry takes full toll of it and pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Ellyse Perry steps out and gets to the pitch of the ball but plays it straight to covers.

DRINKS! New Zealand are still on top in this game! After the three quick wickets, there was a good stand of 50-plus between Perry and Mooney but now that has been broken, Australia have to re-build yet again. The Kiwis would want to continue with the pressure. Australia on the other hand will hoope they can somehow get close to 250 for that these two are key.
Length ball, around off. Ellyse Perry guides it to third man for a single.
On a good length, bowled a little slower. Ellyse Perry comes out and looks to push but gets an inside edge.
Short of a length, outside off. Tahlia McGrath cuts it to deep point for a single.
Well-directed bouncer, on middle. Tahlia McGrath sways away from the line.
Tahlia McGrath flicks this full ball but straight to mid-wicket.
Good-length ball, on off. Tahlia McGrath keeps it out.
Floated up on off, fuller, this is driven towards wide mid off for one. End of a successful over for the hosts. Amelia Kerr has been brilliant in her 5 overs.
Yet another googly, Tahlia McGrath looks to go over covers but it goes off the inner half to mid-wicket.
The googly, it lands and spins back in. Kept out.
On middle, blocked again.
Tossed up on off, defended.
Tahlia McGrath walks out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! Amelia Kerr has got the big wicket of Beth Mooney and she is elated! Beth Mooney on the other hand, can consider herself a touch unlucky. She steps down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. She looks to push it on the off side, it takes the inside edge, then hits the pad and then rolls onto the stumps. Huge wicket and just as the momentum seemed like shifting, New Zealand strike. They are back on top. A good little innings from Mooney but she needed to go on.
Mooney moves into the 30s now! Angled into the pads, it is nudged around the corner for one. A pressure releasing over this one, 9 from it.
FOUR! DEFT! Shorter in length and outside off, Mooney waits and then guides it down to the third man fence. Very clever.
Direct hit would have been close! On off, Perry plays it towards point and takes off. The fielder picks the ball up and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses.
Angled into the pads, Perry looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Just wide! Mooney was worried for a second. On middle, she clips it uppishly but just wide of mid-wicket and down to long on for one.
Outside off, Perry slaps it through covers for one. 50-run stand up between the two. Much-needed for the Aussies but still a lot of work to do. They need to go on.
WIDE! Looks to bolw a bumper but this is way too short. Wided.
Just a single to end! Runs once again hard to comeby now! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
On middle, defended.
Shorter and on off again, this is pushed to cover.
Shorter and on the pads, it is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Mooney misses out! She comes down the track and makes it into a full toss, drives but to covers.
Shorter and around off, Mooney guides it to point.
Another dot to end! Shorter and on middle, Perry pulls but to mid-wicket. It went more off the splice that one.
Back of a length and on middle, Perry works it to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, Perry shows the full face of the bat and strokes it to mid off.
Angled into middle, Mooney works it through mid-wicket for one more.
Angled into the pads, Perry works it through square leg for one.
Drop and run! Brilliant running and the 100 is up! Good recovery so far from these two. On off, Mooney plays it towards cover for one.
On the shorter side again, Perry cuts again but finds point again.
On off, seems like the googly, Perry defends.
Fuller and outside off, Mooney strokes it through covers for one.
Shortish again and outside off, Mooney guides it to point again.
On off, this is pushed to mid off.
Shorter and outside off, Mooney cuts it but finds point.

An appeal for a stumping and it is taken upstairs! NOT OUT! Down the leg side. Mooney looks to flick but misses. She does lose her balance for a second. Katey Martin whips the bails off and appeals but not with a lot of conviction. It is taken upstairs and replays show Mooney is fine. Wided.
Outside off, Ellyse Perry chops it to point.
Tossed up, on off. Mooney drives it past the bowler to long off for one.
Tossed up, on off. Perry drives it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Pierces the gap! Full and on off, Ellyse Perry dances down the track and drives it in between extra cover and mid off. Places it perfectly and gets a boundary.

FOUR! Lovely shot! Drifting away on the pads, Ellyse Perry gets down on her knee and sweeps it to deep square leg. Big chase for the fielder there but could not stop the ball from racing away. A boundary!
Full and on off, Perry bunts it to mid on.
Quicker, on off. Mooney plays it towards point. These two are builing a nice partnership here!
Floats it up, on middle. Beth Mooney flicks it to deep square leg. Calls for two and gets it easily. Good running between the wickets!
Short ball, on middle. Pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A googly again, on middle. Ellyse Perry goes back and works it to mid on.
A googly, well outside off. Mooney cuts it to deep point and settles for a single.
Full and on leg, Mooney defends it on the leg side.
Short and on off, Perry stays back and punches it to mid off.
Tossed up, on middle. Perry keeps it out.
Floats it up, on off. Beth Mooney prods and taps it to cover for a quick single. There is a shy from the fielder at the bowler's end but didn't hit the stumps.
Full and on off, Mooney pushes it to mid off.
Short and outside off, cut away behind point for a brace.
A low full toss, on middle. Perry eases it down to long on for a single.
Short and on leg, Perry pulls it past the bowler for a single.
Full and on off, Ellyse Perry lunges forward to block.
Full and on off, driven towards covers.
On middle, kept out.
Tossed up, outside off. Perry leaves it alone.
A full toss, on off. She gets away with it though as Ellyse Perry hits it straight to cover.
Perry guides this loopy ball to third man for a single.
FOUR! Lovely! A freebie to Ellyse Perry. A full toss, on off and Ellyse Perry shimmies down and lifts it to wide of long off for a boundary.
Full and on off, Beth Mooney uses her feet and plays it to mid off for a single.
On the shorter side, on off. Perry rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy, full and on off. Ellyse Perry steps out and pushes it to mid off.
Loopy ball, outside off. Beth Mooney taps it towards covers and sets off for a single.
Drop and run! So the extra ball accounts for a run! On off, Mooney pushes it towards cover for one.
A short one but it is way too short. Wided.
Make that 10 dots in a row now! On off, this is pushed to mid off.
Another dot! A good short one and on middle, it is ducked under.
Even singles are hard to come by! Shorter and on the body, Mooney nudges it on the leg side. No run.
Shorter and on off, this is played to point.
Good length and on off, Mooney defends.
On off, Perry hits it back to the bowler. Another good over by Frances Mackay!
Floats it up on off, it is played back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, Perry keeps it out.
Perry steps out and gets to the pitch of the ball, she works it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, blocked.
Mooney will be disappointed she did not hit that better! Down the leg side, she sweeps but it goes more off the splice towards fine leg for one.
No she can't! A single to end! Fuller and outside off, Mooney strokes it through covers for one.
Back of a length again and on off, Mooney guides it to point. Can she bowl a maiden?
Lovely stuff from Tahuhu! Good length again and on off, this is pushed to cover.
Shorter and angled into the body, Mooney works it to mid-wicket.
Shorter and outside off, Mooney cuts but the fielder at point does well to stop it.
That is a beauty! This angles in from outside off, it lands and moves away. Mooney looks to defend but does so inside the line and she is beaten. The round the wicket angle is causing problems here.
A dot to end but a good over for the Aussies. Outside off, Perry leaves it alone.
WIDE! The bowler is probably a little unlucky there. Katey Martin did not like that being called a wide. Outside off again, this time Perry leaves it alone. Wided.
WIDE! Very wide outside off, Perry looks to cut but can't reach it.
Angled into the pads, Mooney looks to flick, she gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the leg side for one.
On off, Mooney pushes it to covers.
Around off, Mooney guides it to point.
Two more! Really good running! Outside off, Mooney waits and then plays it past point for two.
FOUR! Lovely timing! Just used the pace of the bowler and bags a handy boundary. Fuller and on middle, this is eased past mid on who is quite wide. Races away.
Nicely played! Around off, back of a length. Perry guides it to point.
Outside off, left alone.
Mooney is off the mark! Shorter and outside off, she waits and then guides it down to third man for one.
Another one on a length and around off, Mooney pushes it to covers.
Back of a length and on off, Beth Mooney waits and then guides it to point.
Beth Mooney is the new batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! Australia are three down and the well-set Rachael Haynes is out of here. Australia in all sorts now. That is a beauty of a delivery from Lea Tahuhu. From around the wicket she angles it in, it lands on middle and then moves away. Haynes does nothing wrong as he tries to play the original line but the movement does her in. It goes past the outside edge and hits the off pole.
Fuller, on off. Rachael Haynes plays a lofted drive and gets a single. A successful over from Hayley Jensen. A wicket and just 2 runs off it.
Length ball, well outside off. Ellyse Perry goes chasing after it as well. She manages to slash it though to third man for a single.
Outside off, on a length, shaping away. Ellyse Perry lets it be.

DRINKS! The Kiwis on top at the moment! They have not let Australia score freely and have also managed to get two big wickets. More of the same is what they would want. Australia on the other hand will hope they can manage to get a stand here and they would want their batters to be a lot more busy. Ellyse Perry walks out.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Hayley Jensen gets a big fish. A huge wicket for New Zealand Women! Short of a length, well outside off. Meg Lanning goes chasing after it. Unusal from her and she perishes. She throws his bat at it and the ball goes off the outside edge to Katey Martin who does not make any mistake. New Zealand Women are right on top at the moment!
Commentary.Howout: c Katey Martin b Hayley Jensen

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length, on off. Meg Lanning stands tall and keeps it out to the off side.
A slow yorker, on leg. Meg Lanning clips it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Short again to Rachael Haynes and once again she pulls it nicely to deep mid-wicket for another boundary. A good over for Australia Women! 10 runs from it.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single. 50 up for Australia Women!
Back of a length, on off. Meg Lanning looks to punch it but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls on the leg side.
Haynes steers this length ball to deep point for a single.
FOUR! Rachael Haynes is so strong on the pull shot. Short ball, outside off. Rachael Haynes picks the length early and pulls it along the carpet to deep mid-wicket. No stopping that! A boundary!
Good-length ball, outside off. Rachael Haynes cuts it off the back foot but straight to Amelia Kerr at point.
This time it's full and outside off. Rachael Haynes pushes it through covers for just a run. Another good over and New Zealand Women continue to keep the pressure.
Good-length ball, on middle, coming back in. Rachael Haynes blocks it right under her eyes.
Length, on middle. Pushed to mid-wicket.
Length ball, outside off. Rachael Haynes plays it towards covers.
Full and on off, Rachael Haynes looks to drive. The ball goes off the inner half to mid-wicket.
WIDE! This time it is bowled way down the leg side and the umpire has no hesitation in giving that as wide.
Length ball, outside off, just inside the tramline. Rachael Haynes lets it sail through thinking it will be given as a wide.
On middle, blocked out by Lanning.

On a length, outside off. Rachael Haynes crunches it towards point. That sounded really good but the fielder at backward point moves to her left and dives to stop the ball. Keeps it to just a single. The fielding from New Zealand Women has been very good.
Fuller in length, outside off. Rachael Haynes goes for the drive but ends up getting an inside edge onto the pads.
Length ball, on leg. Meg Lanning flicks it to deep square leg and crosses ends.
Good running! Touch fuller, on off. Meg Lanning drives it through covers for a brace.
Right on the money! Good-lengh ball, on off. Meg Lanning defends it out.

Hayley Jensen could not get a maiden but still a superb over from her. Length ball, outside off. Meg Lanning gets off the mark by driving it uppishly to point. The fielder there fails to collect the ball. Let's that one through and the batters cross.
Five dots! Length ball, outside off, shaping away. Meg Lanning lets that one go. Can Hayley Jensen get a maiden?
Length ball, outside off. Meg Lanning prods and pushes it towards point. Hayley Jensen is mixing her lengths well here.
Back of a length, on off. Meg Lanning punches it straight to the cover fielder.
Length ball, on off. Meg Lanning taps it to point.
Fuller in length, on off. Meg Lanning digs it out towards covers.
End of Powerplay 1! 3 fielders are now allowed outside the inner circle till the 40th over.
A dot to end! Australia are 37 for 1 after the first 10. On middle, Haynes blocks it out.
Meg Lanning is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Straight to the fielder! Healy falls. This was on the cards. Healy just could not get a move on and she is one who does not like to be quiet for long. She senses an opportunity as this is pitched slightly shorter in length. Healy goes back and pulls, she hits it decently but straight to Amelia Kerr at deep mid-wicket. This is a lovely start for the hosts.
Commentary.Howout: c Amelia Kerr b Frances Mackay

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up on middle, blocked.
Angled into the pads, Haynes works it towards square leg for one.
Flatter and on off, Haynes guides it to point.
On middle, this is worked to square leg, a quick run taken. Had the fielder collected it cleanly, there was a chance for a run out.

FOUR! The last ball spoils the over! Not a good effort in the field. She just over ran it. Shorter and on the body, Haynes pulls it towards fine leg. Rowe runs to her right, the ball lands and then spins away from her. She does not stop it. A boundary. Jensen does not start well, she could have gone for a lot more in that over but still gave away 7.
Really well bowled! A yorker on middle, Haynes flicks but to mid-wicket. Nothing from the Free Hit.
That is very well fielded! On the pads, Haynes flicks, the fielder at square leg dives to her right and stops it. No ball signaled. Free Hit coming. A chance for the Aussies to break the shackles.
Angles it into the pads, Healy clips it down to fine leg for one more.
Fuller and on off, Healy drives but finds cover.
Jensen gets away with one. She has not started all that well. Shorter and outside off, Healy slashes at it but misses.
A little bit of swing, this is on the pads though. Haynes looks to flick, she gets an inside edge onto the pads, it rolls on the leg side for one.
WIDE! Another bowler who starts off with a wide down the leg side. Haynes looks to pull but misses.
Change from both ends! Hayley Jensen is brought into the attack. She replaces Jess Kerr.

Half an appeal but turned down! The bowler was a lot more interested than the keeper who was not sure. Healy looks to be innovative, she tries to play the reverse sweep to this ball outside off. She misses. A good start by Frances Mackay.
Slightly shorter and on off, Healy pushes it to covers.
Gives it air and bowls it on off, fuller, Healy drives it to covers.
Slows it up and lands it on off, defended.
A very full ball outside off, Alyssa Healy looks to jam it out on the off side but misses.
She starts off with one on the pads, Haynes works it towards square leg for one.
First bowling change. Frances Mackay comes into the attack. She replaces Hannah Rowe.
FOUR! She fails to do so! A poor ball to end and the last ball spoils the over. Down the leg side, Healy flicks it down to the fine leg fence. Welcome boundary for the visitors.
Just the one! On middle, this is worked towards square leg. Can Kerr end the over well now?
Well fielded! Fuller and on off, Haynes drives it towards mid off. The fielder gets across to her left and makes a tumbling stop.
Good stuff from Kerr! Length and on off, Haynes hits it to covers.
Good length and on off, Haynes guides it to point.
Wider outside off now, the swing seems to have gone. Haynes drives but to covers.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side. She probably looked to shape it away from middle and leg but it goes on with the angle. Wided.
Another dot! On middle, Healy flicks but to mid-wicket. A good comeback then by the bowler after going for a few in the initial part of the over.
Fuller and on off, Healy pushes it to mid off.
Fuller and outside off, Healy probably looks to hit it way too hard, she gets an underedge on the off side.
Leg bye! On the pads, Haynes misses out. She tries to flick but no connection. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.

Brilliant fielding! Another crisp stroke! Fuller and outside off, Haynes strokes it through covers. The fielder at covers hares after it, she dives forward and pushes it back in. Saves two for her side.
That is a lovely stroke! Did not try to hit it too hard! Fuller and on off, Healy strokes it through covers. Long boundary so it slows up as it reaches the fence, the fielder mops it up, three taken.
Excellent bowling from Jess Kerr! Length ball, outside off. Rachael Haynes pushes it towards covers. A maiden over! This has been a tidy start from New Zealand Women!
Five dots in a row now! Kerr comes 'round the wicket now and bowls a length ball, on middle. Rachael Haynes defends it out.
Four dots in a row! Full again from Kerr, on the pads. Rachael Haynes nudges it to mid-wicket.
On a length, outside off, angling across. Rachael Haynes leaves it alone.
Full again, on leg. Rachael Haynes plays it to mid-wicket.
Fuller in length, on middle. Rachael Haynes drives it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy rides the bounce and cuts it to point. Amelia Kerr dives to her right and stops the ball. Good fielding from Kerr. Just 2 runs off the over then.
Fuller, on middle. Alyssa Healy prods and clips it to mid-wicket.
Length ball, on leg. Rachael Haynes works it to square leg and rotates the strike.
On the pads, Alyssa Healy clips it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Length ball, on off. Alyssa Healy taps it towards covers off the front foot.
Beaten! Good-length ball, outside off, shaping away. Alyssa Healy goes for the booming drive but misses. The ball zips past the outside edge.
A dot to end! Full, on off. Rachael Haynes defends it towards point.
On a length, on middle. Alyssa Healy tucks it to deep square leg and gets off the strike with a single.
Length ball, on off. Driven uppishly towards covers.
Full and on middle, Alyssa Healy defends it down the pitch.
FOUR! Alyssa Healy gets off the mark and in style. Full again, on off, tailing back in. Alyssa Healy prods and works it past mid-wicket. The timing was superb and it races away to the fence.
Full and on off, nipping in. Alyssa Healy drives it to mid on.
Good comeback by Rowe after conceding a boundary off the first ball. Five dots in a row! Good-length ball, on middle. Rachael Haynes keeps it out.
On a length, on top of off. Rachael Haynes punches it towards covers off the back foot.
Good-length ball, on middle, Rachael Haynes meets it with a dead bat.
On a good length, outside off, Rachael Haynes watches the ball closely and makes a leave.
On a good length, on off. Rachael Haynes blocks it out. This is much better from Hannah Rowe!
FOUR! First bounday of the innings! Rowe bowls a length ball, on the pads. The line is too straight and Rachael Haynes tickles it fine to fine leg for a boundary.
Who will bowl from the other end then? Hannah Rowe it is.
Full and outside off, width on offer. Alyssa Healy prods and pushes it to cover. Three from the first over. Good start from New Zealand Women and Jess Kerr.
Fuller, on off, nipping back in. Alyssa Healy pushes it to mid off.
Some swing for Kerr! An inswinging delivery, on off. Alyssa Healy defends it out.
Length ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards covers.
Touch fuller, on off. Alyssa Healy drives it back to the bowler.

Australia Women are underway! Fuller in length, outside off. Rachael Haynes leans onto it and drives it past point. Doesn't have enough legs to clear the boundary but the batters run three. Good running!

We are done with the pre-match formalities and are ready for live action. The players stride out to the middle. Alyssa Healy and Rachael Haynes are the openers for Australia Women. Jess Kerr will start with the ball. Here we go...
Both teams stride out to the middle and lineup for their respective national anthem. It will be Australia's first followed by New Zealand's.

Lea Tahuhu is up for a quick chat. She says that losing their first game wasn't an ideal start for them. Tells that they have taken some learnings forward. Mentions that they have got a number of bowlers who can open the bowling. Adds that when one is given a role, one needs to deliver.

PITCH REPORT - Debbie Hockley and Simon Doull are near the pitch. They reckon that the pitch is good and it's windy and cold. Don't be fooled by the green here. It does assist pace and bounce. It is a belter and it doesn't matter if one bats or bowls first.

Meg Lanning, the Australia Women skipper, says she’s happy to bat first as it seems a good wicket. Mentions Ashleigh Gardner, Darcie Brown and Tahlia McGrath come in. States World Cups are difficult to play in, they are up against a good side but are excited for this game.

Sophie Devine, the New Zealand Women skipper says it is a new wicket and it has a green tinge on it, should be a good one to bat but they want to crack in. States the Aussies have set a benchmark in this format but they are looking forward to this game and are up for it. Informs they are playing the same side.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Rachael Haynes, Meg Lanning (C), Ellyse Perry, Beth Mooney, Tahlia McGrath (In place of Annabel Sutherland), Ashleigh Gardner (In place of Nicola Carey), Alana King, Amanda-Jade Wellington, Megan Schutt, Darcie Brown (In place of Jess Jonassen).

New Zealand Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Suzie Bates, Sophie Devine (C), Amelia Kerr, Amy Satterthwaite, Maddy Green, Katey Martin (WK), Hayley Jensen, Lea Tahuhu, Jess Kerr, Frances Mackay, Hannah Rowe.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and lands in the favor of New Zealand Women. They have elected to BOWL first.

The Kiwis on the other hand, probably played their best cricket of the tournament in their last game against India. The task though is a lot tougher in this game and they will yet again have to be at their top if they are to be of any match to the mighty Aussies. It is familiar conditions for them so they will surely back themselves. Can they topple the Aussies? We will find out.

Have to say the Aussies are probably the best side in this tournament and by a long way. They look unbeatable at the moment and it will something special to get the better of the visitors. They are big time favourites to win this one. Can they make it three in three?

Game 11 of the World Cup and it is a clash between the Trans-Tasman rivals, New Zealand and the Aussies. Both sit on 4 points but the Aussies have played a game less. They are also yet to lose whereas the Kiwis have managed two thumping wins after losing their first. Two teams in good form, this should be a cracking contest. Welcome to the coverage.
